overview: Export Promotion Council for Handicrafts (EPCH) was established under Companies Act in the year 1986-87 and is a non-profit organisation, with an object to promote, support, protect, maintain and increase the export of handicrafts. It is an apex body of handicrafts exporters for promotion of exports of Handicrafts from country and projecting India's image abroad as a reliable supplier of high quality of handicrafts goods & services and ensured various measures keeping in view of observance of international standards and specification. The Council has created necessary infrastructure as well as marketing and information facilities, which are availed both by the members exporters and importers.
objectives: Promote, support, protect, maintain and increase the export of handicrafts
Project India's image abroad as a reliable supplier of high quality handicrafts goods & services
Ensure observance of international standards and specification
Create necessary infrastructure as well as marketing and information facilities for members exporters and importers
eligibility: Any person willing to venture into exports of handicrafts can become the member of the Council. Membership is a pre-condition for registration. Registration can be obtained as a 'Merchant Exporter' or 'Manufacturer Exporter' or Merchant-cum-Manufacturer Exporter as per documents submitted. A self certified copy of Import Export Code (IEC) is mandatory and needs to be enclosed with the application form. If the Company is a partnership firm it has to submit a Partnership Deed along with the Application Form. If the company is a private limited or a limited firm a photocopy of certificate of incorporation (Memorandum of Article of Association) and resolution deed regarding the signing authority has to be submitted. If an Export House applies for member ship it must furnish a copy of Export House Certificate. If a company is a manufacturer exporter must furnish MSME UAM or Udhyam & self declaration certifying what type of Handicrafts product manufacturing. A copy of GSTIN number is required.
benefits: Membership provides access to EPCH's infrastructure, marketing and information facilities. Members can participate in international trade fairs organised by EPCH in India and abroad. EPCH organizes seminars and workshops on training and presenting emerging trends to empower the handicraft community. EPCH provides support to the handicraft community and plays an active role in advancing the sector. EPCH's initiatives include the International Lace Trade Centre, Moradabad Resource Centre, Handicrafts Productivity Centre at Jaipur, Technology Upgradation Centre at Saharanpur, National Centre for Photo & Picture Framing Technology at Saharanpur and Jodhpur, Establishment of International Lace Trade Centre at Narasapur, and Aggressive International Marketing Project for the Development and Promotion of North Eastern Crafts.
financial_support: EPCH is a self-sustaining organisation where all promotional activities are self-financed. Membership fees are the primary source of revenue: Entrance fee in the year of enrolment - Rs. 2500/-, Annual Membership Fee - Rs. 5000/-, Total (during the year of Enrollment) - Rs 7500/- + GST 18% (Rs. 8850/-). Membership renewal fee is Rs. 5900/- (Rs 5000/- + GST 18%). Every year Membership Fee is due on 1st April and payment is to be made by 30th June.
application_process: 1. Apply for New Membership via EPCH website. 2. Pay entrance fee of Rs. 2500/- and annual membership fee of Rs. 5000/- (total Rs. 7500/- + 18% GST = Rs. 8850/-) during the year of enrollment. 3. Submit self certified copy of Import Export Code (IEC). 4. If partnership firm, submit Partnership Deed. 5. If private/limited company, submit photocopy of certificate of incorporation and resolution deed regarding signing authority. 6. If Export House, submit Export House Certificate. 7. If manufacturer exporter, furnish MSME UAM or Udhyam & self declaration certifying type of Handicrafts product manufacturing. 8. Submit copy of GSTIN number. 9. Avoid similar or duplicate names by checking EPCH website member directory. 10. Membership renewal fee of Rs. 5900/- (Rs 5000/- + GST 18%) is due every year by 30th June.
required_documents: Self certified copy of Import Export Code (IEC)
Photocopy of certificate of incorporation (Memorandum of Article of Association) and resolution deed regarding signing authority (if private limited or limited firm)
Export House Certificate (if Export House applies for membership)
MSME UAM or Udhyam & self declaration certifying type of Handicrafts product manufacturing (if manufacturer exporter)
deadlines: Every year Membership Fee is due on 1st April and payment is to be made by 30th June.
caveats: Membership of the Council is a pre-condition for registration.
Registration cum Membership Certificate issued is valid for 5 years subject to renewal of Membership by paying Annual fees every year.
Similar or duplicate names are not allowed; members must check organization name via EPCH website member directory to avoid confusion.
